name: llm-wiki
description: Extract knowledge from any source into a persistent, interlinked Markdown wiki in a Git repository.

interface.shortDescription: Build and sync a Git-backed Markdown wiki.
interface.longDescription: Ingest articles, URLs, papers, transcripts, and notes into a persistent, interlinked Markdown wiki with generated indexes, search, lint, and safe Git sync.
defaultPrompt: Set up my LLM wiki and connect it to my Git repository.
Ingest this source into my wiki: [URL or file path]
Search my wiki for [topic] and cite the relevant pages.
